lines.text: James tells his brothers not to show favoritism, like giving the man with a gold ring a seat of honor and the poor man a place to stand.
God has chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom.
James says the Romans oppress the believers, drag them into court, and blaspheme the noble name by which they are called.
Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at one point is guilty of breaking all of it, as with adultery and murder.
Judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not kept the Sabbath, and wisdom triumphs over judgment.
